description: Greenlit signs in to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube the way you do. No developer apps, no keys: you sign in once, and it stays connected until a platform asks again.
emptyBody: Connect the accounts you already post from. One sign-in brings every channel and Page it manages.

actions.turnedOff: {{name}} is turned off: kept connected, left out of publishing and the sync
actions.disconnectBody: Posts already on the platform stay there and in Greenlit. Its saved sign-in is deleted when no other account uses it.

dialog.pickBody: Choose the platform. You sign in on its own page, shown here; Greenlit keeps the sign-in, never your password.
dialog.qr: Sign in with a QR code from the app

drivers.youtube: YouTube’s own pages: channels, uploads, Shorts.
drivers.youtube-studio: YouTube Studio, for what only Studio does.
drivers.facebook: Your Facebook login: your profile and every Page you manage.
drivers.meta-business-suite: Meta Business Suite: Pages and their Instagram accounts together.
drivers.instagram: Your Instagram login, with reels, stories and music.
drivers.tiktok: TikTok on the web: posts, sounds and covers.
drivers.tiktok-studio: TikTok Studio, for scheduling and photo posts.

remote.title: Sign in to {{platform}}
remote.hint: Sign in as you usually do, including two-step verification. Greenlit only keeps the signed-in session.
remote.qrHint: Open the {{platform}} app on your phone and scan the code.
remote.connectedBody: Everything this sign-in reaches is ready to publish to.
remote.chooseBody: This sign-in reaches several accounts. Pick the ones Greenlit should publish to; you can add others later.
remote.privacy: Typed text goes straight to the page and is never stored.

cookies.title: Paste cookies
cookies.body: When a platform refuses the sign-in window, export your cookies from a browser where you’re signed in (cookies.txt or JSON) and paste them here.
cookies.placeholder:
# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
.instagram.com	TRUE	/	TRUE	…

device.description: Greenlit’s own Android phone, running in Docker. Some things only the platforms’ apps do (YouTube Shorts sounds), so their apps are signed in here.
device.offlineBody: Start it with the android profile: docker compose --profile android up -d
device.notConfiguredBody: Set GREENLIT_ANDROID_ADB to the device’s adb address to use it.
device.interactHint: Clicks become taps, drags become swipes. Type to send text.
device.scanned_one: {{count}} app account joined its connected account
device.scanned_other: {{count}} app accounts joined their connected accounts
device.scanHint: Each app’s account joins the connected account it belongs to.
device.unmatched: Signed in on the device, not connected here
device.unmatchedHint: An app’s account joins only an account already connected in Greenlit with the same id, so these joined none. Connect that account first, or sign the app in to one that is connected. For a Facebook Page, switch the Facebook app to the Page’s profile.
device.unmatchedToast_one: {{count}} app account matches no connected account
device.unmatchedToast_other: {{count}} app accounts match no connected account
